[EN] I am Falim, Halran's assistant. Halran has authorized me to speak on his behalf when he is occupied and should not be otherwise disturbed.
[ES] Soy Falim, el asistente de Halran. Halran me ha autorizado a hablar en su nombre cuando esté ocupado y no deba ser molestado.

[EN] We've been waiting for you.
[ES] Te hemos estado esperando.
